about: Labels of ocr_eval/datasets/commons_scoreboards (see the builder's docstring). Photos were picked on contact sheets of the thumbnails of the candidates (--discover) of the sport categories: physical scoreboards and video boards whose fields looked legible. Each was then looked at in full; 'rejected' lists those that turned out unusable ('category: detail'). Boxes are [x, y, w, h] in the pixels of the photo's rendition of the given size (1280 px wide, or the original if narrower), drawn like a ScoreSight box around one field. Texts are exactly what the display shows; fields that weren't clearly legible were left out. 'group' marks photos of the same board and game, which share a split.
